problem_type: Canvas-wide transient UI state released by per-owner bookkeeping that later gestures can overwrite
symptom: On main 195bf3a2c (and already on 46b71c973) the user selects an image node, empty or already generated, and the generation composer does not appear, so there is no parameter bar. Clicking the '2 版' version pill opens nothing: the result tray is rendered but invisible. The floating node toolbar is gone too, and the state persists until the next complete drag-pan.
direct_cause: GenerationCanvasReactFlowViewport.onMoveEnd released the react-flow-viewport dragging owner only if canvasPanMovedRef was still true. @xyflow/system createPanZoomEndHandler defers onPanZoomEnd by 150ms when panOnScroll is on (the user's modifier-zoom scheme) and by 0ms otherwise. Any pointerdown inside .react-flow__pane in that window resets canvasPanMovedRef=false. That includes a pointerdown on a node, because nodes live inside the pane. The deferred onMoveEnd then skips the release and data-dragging='true' stays on the stage.
class_root: The stage-level data-dragging flag had no lifetime bound. Every owner (node drag, selection drag, group drag, pointer pan, viewport pan) is a pointer gesture, yet release depended entirely on each owner's own bookkeeping. Any timing that skips one owner's release left every node overlay (composer, floating toolbar, version tray) invisible indefinitely.
affected_population: Every canvas user; with the modifier-zoom wheel scheme (Figma-style, trackpad users) the window is 150ms after every drag-pan, with wheel-zoom it is the 0ms timer tick
Wheel or trackpad panning never releases the stuck owner, so trackpad users stay stuck for the rest of the session
entry_points: Drag-pan then click a node or blank within the deferred move-end window
Drag-pan followed by a wheel/programmatic viewport move within that window
Any future owner whose own release is skipped by a timing race

external_sources.purpose: createPanZoomEndHandler defers onPanZoomEnd with setTimeout(panOnScroll ? 150 : 0); installed @xyflow/system@0.0.81 dist/esm/index.mjs lines 2848-2872 read locally

invariants: data-dragging on a canvas stage never outlives the pointer gesture that raised it: after pointerup / pointercancel / window blur no owner remains
A viewport move end always releases the viewport owner (idempotent)

door_reduction.why_not: Each door is a different gesture owner (selection drag, legacy node drag, RF node drag start/stop, RF viewport pan, host pointer pan). They legitimately start and stop at different moments; merging them would re-couple unrelated gestures. The class is closed at the shared flag module (armGestureEndGuard) that every door writes through, so no door can leak past the gesture regardless of its own timing.

generality_proof: 每一扇写口拿的都是同一个 `beginCanvasDragging` 租约。第一次升旗就给那张 stage 装上手势兜底闸，pointerup / pointercancel / 窗口 blur 之后等一帧，仍挂着的租约一律收掉。于是任何一位现有或将来的 owner、任何时序竞态、任何指针类型或平台上「漏了一次 release」，都被这一次手势框住。视口那条具体竞态另外在源头修好了：`onMoveEnd` 无条件 `release()`，不再按「这次平移动过没」那个会被重置的布尔判断。

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single owner of the stage data-dragging attribute: one lease per gesture, and the flag's lifetime is bounded by that pointer gesture (armGestureEndGuard)
Viewport owner always released at move end

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Walkthrough G2/G3 red on 46b71c973 and 195bf3a2c (data-dragging='true' stuck), green after fix
Releases only when draggingRef is set; if RF never fires drag stop (node unmounted mid-drag) the guard clears on pointerup. Unit class test iterates every CANVAS_DRAGGING_OWNER
Already released on window pointerup/blur; now also bounded by the shared guard
Pointer-pan owner cleared on pointer end; bounded by guard for pointercancel/blur (walkthrough G7/G8)

recurrence.reason: The flag has six independent writers and one of them already leaked through a third-party timer. Any new owner or timing change can leak the same way, and the effect is every overlay on the canvas disappearing.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs beginCanvasDragging armGestureEndGuard cancelCanvasDraggingWithin → 7 writer doors, 11 call sites（2026-09-22 总合并换成租约模型之后重数）
grep '\[dragging=true\]/canvas' → NodeGenerationComposer, NodeFloatingToolbar, NodeResultStack all hide on the flag
grep canvasPanMovedRef → pointerdown on .react-flow__pane (which contains nodes) resets it

prevention.invariant: No dragging owner survives pointerup, pointercancel or window blur on the stage
prevention.failure_mode: The guard clears every owner and removes the attribute, so overlays become visible again. A late owner release is a no-op.
prevention.strategy: The flag module arms a one-shot capture listener per stage when the first owner is raised and disarms it when the last owner releases normally

legacy_paths.rationale: The conditional release keyed on canvasPanMovedRef in onMoveEnd is removed and replaced by an unconditional idempotent release

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The 150ms deferral is documented xyflow behaviour for panOnScroll (debouncing scroll end), not a defect; our release must not depend on it. No upgrade changes it.

migration:
None: transient in-memory DOM attribute, nothing persisted.

2026-09-22 总合并订正（主会话裁决：data-dragging 取打捞分支的**租约模型**，同时原样保留本合同的行为级测试）：升旗/摘旗的入口从 `setCanvasDragging(origin, dragging, owner)` 换成 `beginCanvasDragging(...) → {activate, release, cancel}` 一张租约，宿主隐藏那条走 `cancelCanvasDraggingWithin`。本合同要守的那条不变量**一个字没改**——「标志的寿命上限 = 这一次指针手势」——它现在由 `canvasDraggingFlag.armGestureEndGuard` 实现（pointerup/pointercancel/窗口 blur + 等一帧的 epoch 兜底），行为级测试（`canvasDraggingFlag.test.ts` 的「the flag never outlives the pointer gesture」四条）改用租约 API 表达、断言逐条保留。门表按新符号重锚。
residual_risks: A programmatic viewport move while no pointer is down cannot raise the flag (canvasPanMovedRef is false then), so the guard waiting for the next pointerup is sufficient; not independently proven for touch pinch.
The integration branch (ab9460f45, unpushed) replaces this module with a lease model; its owner will keep the behaviour-level walkthrough as the shared acceptance.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The flag module is the only writer of data-dragging, so it owns the lifetime bound. Unit tests cover every owner. The walkthrough is the behavioural positive control: red on 46b71c973 and 195bf3a2c, green after the fix.
